filament_notes:
• temp°: 250° is the best, 230° second best. In manufacturer-approved range 230..250 every temp has a bit of stringing, but amusingly the largest amount was in between. 250 actually has *tiny bit* more stringing than 230, but has the very corner of overhang also printed tiny bit better.
• Max flowrate: no visible artifacts from 5 up to 20 mm³/s. Presumably I can go higher, but set to 19 for now.
• Pressure advance (w/ bowden tube): 0.1 already looks bad, 0 looks bad too but in a different way. Increasing values become worse. 0.05 seems to have been the best result.
• Retraction: in between 0mm..6mm with step 0.25mm, the 2d ring shows best (0.25). In between 0mm..1.2mm with step 0.1mm the 0.1 is okay already. Set to 0.2 just in case.
name: Syntech ABS (green, bowden, 0.6nz)
